summary: Conversion to std::time::Duration checked only normalized seconds, incorrectly accepting negative subsecond durations. For seconds = 0 and nanos = -1, casting nanos to u32 produced Ok(4.294967295s) instead of NegativeDuration with magnitude 1ns. The fix also requires nonnegative nanos. The commit adds a deterministic regression test for this case; no tests were executed during planning.
expected_failure: assertion failed: matches!(time::Duration::try_from(neg_prost_duration), Err(DurationError::NegativeDuration(d)) if d == std_duration,)
